Accell Group , a Dutch bikemaker taken private by KKR for €1.6b in 2022, is entering an insolvency process.
Arcwood Environmental , a portfolio company of EQT and Ardian , acquired Environmental Management Services , a Rockland, Md.-based waste management company.
Bain Capital agreed to buy bubble tea chain Gong Cha from TA Associates .

deals.company: CVC Capital Partners and Veritas Capital each bid around £1.6b to buy British heat treatment firm Bodycote (LSE: BOY).

Gorgeous Collective , a portfolio company of MPK Equity Partners , acquired Clean Your Dirty Face , a Chicago-based skin care and spa franchise.

deals.company: I Squared Capital agreed to acquire Cella
deals.note: I Squared Capital agreed to acquire Cella , an Indonesian industrial logistics and cold storage platform, from NWP Property and CRE .
KKR agreed to buy the India hospital unit of Sweden's Medicover (ST: MCOV) for €1.2b.

deals.company: LS Power agreed to acquire the Brazos Valley Energy Center
deals.note: LS Power agreed to acquire the Brazos Valley Energy Center , a 606-MW natural gas-fired facility in Texas, from Constellation Energy (Nasdaq: CEG).
Mortgage Automator , a BVP Forge portfolio company, acquired Lendr , a Chicago-based provider of working-capital and invoice-factoring programs for small businesses.

deals.company: Tortuga Growth Partners invested in Advanced eClinical Training

deals.company: Veritas Capital acquired a majority stake in Saber Power Services
deals.note: Veritas Capital acquired a majority stake in Saber Power Services, a Houston-based power infrastructure services platform, from Greenbelt Capital Management .

Braveheart Bio , an SF-based developer of therapeutics for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, raised $382.5m in its IPO. It sold 21.3m shares at $18, versus plans to sell 18.8m at $15-$17, and will list on the Nasdaq (BRVE). Braveheart had raised $185m in VC funding from a16z, Forbion, OrbiMed, Enavate Sciences, and Frazier Life Sciences.
